If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counter pessimism.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast peaks >1.5% above recent high, cap forecast at 1.5% above recent high for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast dips >1.5% below recent low, adjust down by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon to avoid excessive pessimism.  
If sentiment is volatile (alternating >0.67 and <0.33) in last 5 days, apply smoothing: reduce forecast slope by 0.2–0.5% per day for early horizon.  
If sentiment is consistently >0.67 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to prevent overcorrection.
